badge.es: De matón de barrio a duelista que se para después del golpe de Ra
badge.en: From street kid to the Duelist who stands up after Ra's blast

origin.es: Yu-Gi-Oh! (manga y anime): Jonouchi en Japón, Joey en el doblaje inglés
origin.en: Yu-Gi-Oh! (manga and anime): Jonouchi in Japan, Joey in the English dub

p.es: Joey y su hermana Serenity crecen separados: cuando los padres se divorcian, él tiene 10 años, ella se va con la madre y él se queda con el padre. En la escuela hostiga a Yugi y arroja a la pileta una pieza del Millennium Puzzle. Ushio los golpea, Yugi los defiende y Joey rescata la pieza y se la devuelve. El odio hacia Kaiba nace cuando este rompe el Blue-Eyes del abuelo de Yugi. Como el mazo de Joey solo tiene monstruos, Yugi le propone tomar clases con Solomon.
p.en: Joey and his sister Serenity end up apart: when their parents divorce he is 10, she goes with their mother and he stays with their father. At school he bullies Yugi and drops a piece of the Millennium Puzzle into the pool. Ushio beats them up, Yugi defends them, and Joey retrieves the piece and returns it. His hatred of Kaiba begins when Kaiba tears up the Blue-Eyes of Yugi's grandfather. Since Joey's Deck holds only monsters, Yugi proposes lessons with Solomon.

p.es: Joey va con Yugi a Duelist Kingdom: Yugi le da un Star Chip y él quiere el premio para pagar la operación de ojos de Serenity. Apostando el Time Wizard que Yugi le regaló, le gana a Rex Raptor y se queda con su Red-Eyes Black Dragon. Yami Bakura lo atrapa en la carta de Flame Swordsman y Joey se sacrifica por Yugi, hasta que lo reviven. Kaiba lo derrota, pero vence a Keith gracias a una tarjeta de Mai. En la final pierde con Yugi, que le da el premio para Serenity.
p.en: Joey goes with Yugi to Duelist Kingdom: Yugi gives him a Star Chip and he wants the prize money for Serenity's eye operation. Betting the Time Wizard that Yugi gave him, he beats Rex Raptor and takes his Red-Eyes Black Dragon. Yami Bakura traps him in the Flame Swordsman card and Joey sacrifices himself for Yugi, until he is revived. Kaiba defeats him, but he beats Keith thanks to a card from Mai. In the final he loses to Yugi, who gives him the prize money for Serenity.

p.es: Kaiba le da una clasificación baja, pero un funcionario ve su Red-Eyes Black Dragon, la corrige y avisa a los Rare Hunters. Camino a la operación de Serenity, Seeker lo vence con Exodia y se queda con el Red-Eyes; Yugi vence a Seeker y la recupera, pero Joey insiste en que Yugi la conserve. Después Marik, con el Millennium Rod, lo posee y lo obliga a duelear con Yugi, encadenados a un ancla. Joey se libera, Yugi se dirige Meteor of Destruction a sí mismo, Joey fuerza el empate y Serenity lo rescata.
p.en: Kaiba gives him a low rating, but an official spots his Red-Eyes Black Dragon, corrects it and tips off the Rare Hunters. On his way to Serenity's operation, Seeker beats him with Exodia and takes the Red-Eyes; Yugi beats Seeker and wins it back, but Joey insists Yugi keep it. Then Marik, with the Millennium Rod, possesses him and forces him to Duel Yugi, chained to an anchor. Joey breaks free, Yugi aims Meteor of Destruction at himself, Joey forces a draw and Serenity rescues him.

p.es: En los cuartos de final, Joey enfrenta a Odion, que se hace pasar por Marik. El Ra de Odion es falso, el verdadero se enfurece y tumba a los dos; gana quien se pare primero, y Joey, soñando con sus amigos, se levanta. En la semifinal, Marik invoca a The Winged Dragon of Ra y Joey sigue de pie tras el golpe, roba Gearfried the Iron Knight y cae antes de atacar. Kaiba reconoce que Joey no es un aficionado cualquiera.
p.en: In the quarter-finals, Joey faces Odion, who poses as Marik. Odion's Ra is a fake, the real one is angered and strikes down both players; whoever stands up first wins, and Joey, dreaming of his friends, gets up. In the semi-final, Marik Summons The Winged Dragon of Ra and Joey is still standing after the blast, draws Gearfried the Iron Knight and collapses before attacking. Kaiba admits Joey is no mere amateur.

h.es: Hermos, Mai y el Grand Championship (anime)
h.en: Hermos, Mai and the Grand Championship (anime)

p.es: En Waking the Dragons, Joey saca una espada de un dragón sellado en cristal y The Claw of Hermos entra a su mazo. Contra Mai, bajo el Seal of Orichalcos, la usa para tomar ventaja, hasta que Valon interviene. Más adelante, agotado por el duelo con Valon, empuja a Mai fuera del Seal mientras le quitan el alma; la recupera cuando Yami Yugi vence a Dartz. En el Grand Championship, Yugi dice que Heart of the Underdog le recuerda a un amigo, y llamar underdog a Joey se vuelve un chiste constante.
p.en: In Waking the Dragons, Joey pulls a sword from a dragon sealed in crystal and The Claw of Hermos joins his Deck. Against Mai, under the Seal of Orichalcos, he uses it to gain the advantage, until Valon interrupts. Later, exhausted from his Duel with Valon, he pushes Mai out of the Seal as his soul is taken; it returns when Yami Yugi defeats Dartz. In the Grand Championship, Yugi says Heart of the Underdog reminds him of a friend, and calling Joey an underdog becomes a running gag.

p.es: En el manga, Jonouchi vive entre las deudas de su papá y pasa por la banda de Hirutani. Molesta a Yugi y tira una pieza del Puzzle a la pileta. Tras ver un video de Shizuka, cuenta que ella está por perder la vista, y Yugi reparte sus Star Chips con él. Contra Keith, Mai le da su tarjeta de clasificación y Jonouchi gana convirtiendo su Red-Eyes en Red-Eyes Black Metal Dragon (copia Metalmorph) con ayuda de Dragon Nails. No juega la final: le pasa a Yugi The Honor of the King's Right.
p.en: In the manga, Jonouchi lives amid his dad's debts and spends time in Hirutani's gang. He picks on Yugi and throws a piece of the Puzzle into the pool. After watching a video from Shizuka, he explains she is close to losing her sight, and Yugi splits his Star Chips with him. Against Keith, Mai hands him her qualification card and Jonouchi wins by turning his Red-Eyes into Red-Eyes Black Metal Dragon (copying Metalmorph) with help from Dragon Nails. He skips the final and gives Yugi The Honor of the King's Right.

p.es: Un empleado corrige la clasificación de Jonouchi al ver su Red-Eyes y avisa a los Rare Hunters. El del Exodia lo vence; Yugi recupera la carta con la regla de ante, pero Jonouchi la rechaza hasta ganársela y juega con Time Wizard; contra Roba gana a Jinzo. Marik lo posee y lo obliga a duelear con Yugi, encadenados a un ancla. Poseído, usa Rocket Warrior para debilitar el Red-Eyes de Yugi; se libera y fuerza el empate, y Kaiba le tira la otra llave al agua.
p.en: A clerk corrects Jonouchi's rating on seeing his Red-Eyes and tips off the Rare Hunters. The Exodia one defeats him; Yugi wins the card back through the ante rule, but Jonouchi refuses it until he earns it and plays with Time Wizard; against Roba he wins Jinzo. Marik possesses him and forces him to Duel Yugi, chained to an anchor. Possessed, he uses Rocket Warrior to weaken Yugi's Red-Eyes; he breaks free and forces a draw, and Kaiba drops the other key into the water.

h.es: Rishid y el golpe de Ra (manga)

p.es: En los cuartos de final, Jonouchi enfrenta a Rishid, que dice ser Marik. Rishid contesta su Giant Trunade con Judgment of Anubis, y después sus Embodiment of Apophis lo dejan en 50 puntos de vida. El Ra de Rishid es falso, el verdadero se enfurece y tumba a los dos; gana quien se pare primero, y Jonouchi, soñando con sus amigos, se levanta. Rishid cuenta que es la sombra de Marik. Luego, Dark Marik convierte en Shadow Game el duelo de Mai y Jonouchi intenta liberarla de Ra, hasta que Dark Yugi lo protege.
p.en: In the quarter-finals, Jonouchi faces Rishid, who claims to be Marik. Rishid answers his Giant Trunade with Judgment of Anubis, and then his Embodiment of Apophis cards leave him at 50 Life Points. Rishid's Ra is a fake, the real one is angered and strikes down both players; whoever stands up first wins, and Jonouchi, dreaming of his friends, gets up. Rishid says he is Marik's shadow. Then Dark Marik turns Mai's Duel into a Shadow Game and Jonouchi tries to free her from Ra, until Dark Yugi shields him.

notes.es: Primero va el relato del anime y después el del manga; cada bloque dice en el título cuál sigue. Los nombres cambian (Joey y Serenity en el anime en inglés, Jonouchi y Shizuka en el manga). La wiki marca como incompleto el relato del manga desde Battle City, así que ahí es parcial. Las películas (Pyramid of Light, The Dark Side of Dimensions y Bonds Beyond Time) no se cuentan acá. No se enlaza ninguna pieza de creadores porque no encontramos una que se pudiera abrir y comprobar.
notes.en: The anime story comes first and the manga story after it; each block says in its title which one it follows. Names differ (Joey and Serenity in the English dub, Jonouchi and Shizuka in Japanese). The wiki marks its manga account from Battle City onward as incomplete, so that part is partial. The films (Pyramid of Light, The Dark Side of Dimensions and Bonds Beyond Time) are not covered here. No creator piece is linked because we found none that could be opened and checked.
